title: Chapter 667 - 667 Mecha Battle; Regret! (2)

Chapter 667 - 667 Mecha Battle; Regret! (2)

Chapter 667 - 667 Mecha Battle; Regret! (2)

667 Mecha Battle; Regret! (2)

However, he had just used up his stamina to defeat a mecha. Now, he was facing two more mechas. He would definitely not be able to take it.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s voice floated into his mind.

“It’s me and Xia Xue.”

Li Dongqiang’s footsteps paused slightly.

Then, he received a communication request.

“It’s really you!” Li Dongqiang said happily.

Alone, it was easy to be attacked.

However, if the three of them formed a group, very few people would dare to provoke them.

Xia Xue looked up at the count.

[Time: 99:51]

[Number of people: 910]

“There are only 99 minutes left,” Xia Xue said.

Lin Fan knew that Xia Xue also cared about this competition.

Otherwise, she would not have specially trained during the three days of the holiday.

Thus, Lin Fan said, “It’s almost time for us to earn points.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan controlled his mecha to take a step forward. In an instant, he blocked a mecha and slammed down with his palm.

The energy core shattered, earning him a point!

“Good job!” Li Dongqiang laughed. “Watch me!”

Then, he stopped another person.

However, Li Dongqiang was not as fast as Lin Fan.

In fact, he almost flipped the mecha over.

Thanks to Lin Fan’s timely help, Li Dongqiang was able to shatter the energy core.

At this time, Xia Xue also stopped a mecha.

Lin Fan and Li Dongqiang turned around to help.

The ending was self-evident.

Xia Xue quickly got one point.

With the three of them working together, especially with Lin Fan, who was ranked number one in terms of strength, they could naturally kill everyone and everything!

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang’s scores kept rising.

…

In front of Group 7’s building.

There was a huge 3D projection in front of Li Ke, displaying the battle scene in the entire building.

The audience in the distance gasped in admiration from time to time.

“As expected of students from the three major universities!”

“That’s amazing!”

“I can barely operate the mecha to run.”

“This is too exciting!”

…

Li Ke’s stern eyes swept through the battles as he silently analyzed them.

When he saw the small group of three mechas, his gaze could not help but linger for a few more seconds.

…

[Time: 23:33]

[Number of people: 589]

As time passed, some people discovered the great benefits of being in small groups.

Therefore, they intentionally looked for people who they were familiar with, were from the same grade, or were from the same school to form groups.

Not long after, several large groups of dozens or even 20 to 30 people appeared.

After the individual players were dealt with, some of the larger groups turned their attention to the smaller groups.

In the distance, there was a sudden burst of violent footsteps.

A large group of 18 people rushed toward Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang.

They looked like a pack of hungry wolves who had just seen three fat sheep.

Among them, the mecha that was running at the front turned on the external sound system and said, “I found you!”

It was Zhao Ting, who had clashed with Li Dongqiang and the others earlier.

Li Dongqiang frowned when he heard the voice.

Li Dongqiang had wanted to find trouble with Zhao Ting earlier, but the invigilator arrived.

Now, they finally met.

However, the other party was in a group of 18 people.

“What should we do now?” Li Dongqiang asked in a low voice.

Lin Fan smiled. “Someone is delivering points to us again. Can’t we just accept them?”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step forward and rushed forward.

He was completely fearless!

Perhaps Lin Fan’s actions had touched Li Dongqiang.

“Alright!” he added.

Xia Xue did not speak. She followed closely behind Lin Fan.

Thus, a very strange scene appeared.

The three lone mechas that looked like little sheep charged straight at the 18 mechas that looked like hungry wolves.

Lin Fan, who was controlling his mecha, suddenly changed his stance and slashed down.

A mecha’s energy core shattered.

Then, Lin Fan punched the back of another mecha, causing it to stagger and fall toward Li Dongqiang.

Li Dongqiang seized the opportunity and threw a shot.

Score!

Lin Fan kicked out, and the mecha beside him fell to the ground.

Xia Xue quickly waved her knife.

Score!

….

In front of Group 7’s building.

Li Ke’s gaze once again fell on the small group of three mechas.

He muttered in his heart, “These three people…”

He raised his hand and tapped lightly, and the information of the three people immediately jumped out in front of him.

“Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and Lin Fan?”

“Lin Fan? He has the same name as the hero from a thousand years ago.”

Then, Li Ke sighed and said, “Is that hero also watching this examination?”

…

How could he know that the hero was not just watching it?

He was directly involved in it.

…

Even though Lin Fan did not use his own strength and was just operating the mecha like a normal student, his skills were still not something that ordinary people could compare to.

Soon, Zhao Ting was the only one left standing in the group of 18.

He looked around at Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang.

Finally, he shouted, “Die!”

He charged toward Lin Fan with all his might.

In his opinion, Lin Fan had been attacking all this while He was definitely exhausted now.

Unfortunately, Zhao Ting was destined to be disappointed.

Lin Fan’s body shook, and he smashed Zhao Ting onto the ground.

“Li Dongqiang, I’ll leave it to you.”

“Thanks!” Li Dongqiang said.

He slashed at Zhao Ting’s energy core.

This battle of three against 18 was a complete victory!

The following time became even more intense.

Everyone wanted to get more points at the last moment.

One after another, large groups erupted into battle. It was extremely tragic.

The small group of three formed by Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang was not attacked at all.

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang were not attacked, and they were too lazy to take the initiative to find trouble.

Hence, a strange scene appeared in Group 7’s building.

Sparks flew in all directions from the large groups.

However, there were three lonely mechas standing at the side like spectators.

At this moment, a loud and clear voice sounded in Group 7’s building.

“The match is over! Everyone stop fighting and come out of the building!”

As soon as that was said, there were people who heaved a sigh of relief, some felt helpless, and others who were excited… Their expressions were all different.

Following that, everyone piloted their slightly damaged mechas and returned to the square.

Li Ke’s sharp eyes swept across the crowd.

When he saw Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang, he could not help but pause for a few more seconds.

After a while, he said, “The first round of the mecha competition ends here!”

“Now, let’s announce the scores!”

Immediately, a clear 3D projection appeared in the air.

[Lin Fan: 39 points]

[Xia Xue: 33 points]

[Li Dongqiang: 31 points]

[Qiao Hun: 26 points]

[Zhu Chaoqun: 19 points]

…

The top three were taken by Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang.

Among them, Lin Fan had the highest score.

In reality, Lin Fan was not interested in the number of points he got and whether he was first or not.

Many times, he would beat the enemy to the point of being half-crippled so that Xia Xue and Li Dongqiang could make the last move.

Xia Xue and Li Dongqiang also knew that in the small group of three, Lin Fan had the greatest contribution.

Therefore, there were a few times when they kicked the enemy back in front of Lin Fan.

That was why Lin Fan had gotten the highest score.

…

“The morning exam ends here. The arena competition will begin at 2 PM!” Li Ke said.

After saying that, he did not stop at all. He turned around and walked into the distance.

As soon as he left, the scene immediately erupted into a clamor of discussion.

“So, mecha battles are actually like this. If I had known earlier, I would’ve formed a group when I entered.”

“Standard mechas are too difficult to operate. It would’ve been better if I used my own mecha.”

“I actually got zero points.”

“Hey!”

…

The round-faced Tian Zhiwu squeezed through the crowd and said, “Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, aren’t your mecha piloting skills too amazing?

“Especially Lin Fan. Your mecha skills are way above the data. I’m afraid you’re already a B+! If I had known earlier, I would’ve gone in and stayed with you. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been eliminated after only staying in the building for two minutes.”

As he said this, Tian Zhiwu’s features were scrunched up. He was extremely regretful.
